artboards.title: (a) Paper Trail records Cc · (c) settled badge + undo
(b) Paper Trail reply keeps the people copied

annotations.text: OWNER ASK, 2026-10-09 — “Yes to all” to three follow-ups to Letters Cc (#313): (a) record who was copied, (b) replies keep the copied people, (c) a way to tell Home a reply needs no answer. All names here are invented.
